extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) granted approval to abemaciclib in combination with an aromatase inhibitor as an initial endocrine-based therapy for the treatment of adult patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor 2 (HER2)-negative advanced or metastatic breast cancer. This indication is based on the MONARCH 3 (NCT02246621) clinical trial, which was a randomized (2:1), double-blinded, placebo-controlled, multicenter study. A total of 493 patients were randomized to receive 150 mg abemaciclib or placebo orally twice daily, plus physician's choice of letrozole (80% of patients) or anastrozole (20%).
